messages:
Alex Kim: Heads up — SOC2 evidence packaging + audit-log retention boundaries planning. Need to align for H2 roadmap; customers asking for per-tenant retention & export.
Maria Gonzalez: Adding to roadmap sync. We need clear launch criteria: searchable logs for 90d, immutable storage, and KMS per-org support?
Priya Rao: 90d is typical for SOC2 ops but enterprise customers want 1y+ options and legal-hold. MVP: support KMS BYOK wrapping; HSM attestation later.
Jordan Lee: We also need to define the evidence ingest pipeline: which events (auth, admin actions, model deployments, key ops), schema (JSON with trace ids), and TTL semantics. How will exports look?
Sam Patel: Infra note: storing full audit payloads 1y = ~X TB/mo (rough). We should offer retention tiers: hot (90d), warm (90-365d), cold/archive (365+). Need cost estimates.
Alex Kim: Quick lifecycle example for discussion:
```
PUT lifecycle rule:
- Prefix: audit/
- Transition: 90d -> Archive
- Expire: 365d
```
Maria Gonzalez: Also need proof of key rotation for SOC2: rotation logs + signed attestations. Compliance Bot: Reminder: SOC2 checklist item 4 requires mapped key custodians and rotation evidence.
Priya Rao: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- 1) Audit logs capture required key actions (deploy, model-change, access/grant)
- 2) Retention policy configurable per-org (min 90d, option up to 3y)
- 3) KMS integration (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK) + BYOK support
- 4) Export API and immutable evidence bundle for legal hold
- 5) Console views for retention and evidence packaging + audit trail
Jordan Lee: Questions about scope: BYOK with per-org keys ok for MVP, BYOK per-tenant/hsm-per-tenant is expensive and needs product signoff. Also need to define indexing/search surface for logs.
Sam Patel: From infra: encryption-at-rest + server-side integrity hashes needed before archiving. We'll need lifecycle jobs to rehydrate for exports.
Alex Kim: Customer asks: ACME and BetaBank specifically requested HSM attestation and longer retention. We should capture these as customer-driven stretch items.
Maria Gonzalez: Suggested prioritization for OKRs: KMS BYOK and retention UI = Q2 must-have; HSM attestation and per-tenant export SLA = Q4 stretch. Owners: eng-security (Alex/Priya), eng-infra (Sam), product (Maria), platform (Jordan).
Jordan Lee: Action items: 1) finalize event list (Jordan) 2) cost impact model + storage calc (Sam) 3) retention UI mock + product doc (Maria) 4) KMS integration spec + rotation proof (Priya) 5) compliance test matrix + evidence packaging format (Alex). Target: draft by EOW next Friday.
Priya Rao: I'll start the KMS spec doc and loop in legal for evidence packaging formats (signed bundles, manifest schema).
Alex Kim: Cool — I'll add this to the roadmap doc and bring to product prioritization on Thu. @product please review the stretch asks. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks everyone — will block 30m on Friday to review the draft and cost estimates.
Compliance Bot: System: New checklist item created: "audit-ingest-and-retention-bounds". Owner assigned: Alex Kim.
